messages:
Alex (PM): Quick heads-up — post-launch backlog looks noisy. We need a short play to decide which customer-reported items become immediate bugs vs queued enhancements. I propose a 2-step triage: severity + customer impact weighting.
Maria (Eng): Agreed. Can we define severity buckets that map to response windows? e.g. P0 (prod crash), P1 (major loss of core flow), P2 (minor regression), P3 (cosmetic).
Jin (Product Ops): That aligns with customer asks. Also want to factor in "customer momentum" — number of active customers affected and whether it's on Dedicated/Private.
Sam (SRE): From ops perspective, anything causing p99 latency regressions on the hosted API should be P1 or higher. Want us to include telemetry link? /cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Perf alert: streaming-generator queue growth spike at 2026-03-18T09:12:21Z. Link: https://infra/reports/streaming-queue-20260318
Alex (PM): Thanks — that's helpful. Proposed quick rule for this sprint (one-liner we can enforce): if severity in [P0,P1] OR affected_customers>=3 OR affects Dedicated customers => triage to hotfix sprint; else queue for next micro-iteration.
Maria (Eng): Can we add acceptance criteria requirement? For hotfix: owner assigned, reproducer, telemetry dashboard, and rollback plan. I can template that.
Jin (Product Ops): I'll own customer comms for hotfix items and map customers to SLA tiers. Also suggest a small slot each weekday (30m) for hotfix grooming to avoid context switching.
Alex (PM): Good. What about items that are "edge but technically easy" — small UX polish reported by 1 customer but trivial to fix. Should we allow fast-path small-polish patching?
Sam (SRE): Yes if risk low and change isolated. Add rule: low-risk code change + <2 hrs dev + automated tests pass => cherry-pick to patch release.
Maria (Eng): I'll add a quick checklist snippet to the issue template. Example snippet: ```Triage: P1
Customers affected: 4
Repro steps: yes
Owner: @maria
Acceptance: perf-dashboard linked, e2e test added, rollback tag ready```
Alex (PM): Love it. Next: backlog visibility. Jin, can you add a "postlaunch-prio" label and a triage column in the product board? We need to avoid burying things.
Jin (Product Ops): On it. I'll create label and move current tickets tagged "customer-urgent" into a triage swimlane. Also will add a custom field: "Impact score" (0-10).
Maria (Eng): One ask — please include estimated dev cost (T-shirt) so engineering can quickly flag obvious enhancements.
Alex (PM): We'll capture: severity, impacted_customers, environment (hosted/dedicated/private), dev_estimate, risk, and impact_score. We'll run this for 2 sprints and revisit thresholds.
Sam (SRE): For the hotfix sprint, propose reserve 25% of squad capacity for mitigations/rollbacks. Otherwise we burn out when things land.
Jin (Product Ops): Scheduling: hotfix grooming M-F 10:15-10:45, weekly review Friday 16:00 for backlog adjustments. I'll send recurring invites.
Alex (PM): Action items: Maria to add issue template + checklist (due EOD), Jin to add label/board fields + invites (due tomorrow), Sam to confirm reserved capacity with Eng leads (due tomorrow). I'll consolidate rules into a short runbook and post here.
Maria (Eng): Working on template now, will link PR.
Jin (Product Ops): Board updated and invites sent.
Alex (PM): Runbook draft: "If (severity in P0/P1) OR (impacted_customers>=3) OR (affects Dedicated/Private) => hotfix sprint; else if (low-risk && dev_estimate<=2hrs) => fast-patch; else => backlog prioritized by impact_score. Reserve 25% capacity for ops. Hotfix grooming M-F 10:15." I'll post the canonical doc when done.
Sam (SRE): +1. Also recommend automated alert for when a single issue is flagged by 3+ customers in 7 days to auto-escalate.
Alex (PM): Good idea. Jin, can you add that as a watch rule?
Jin (Product Ops): Yep — adding a watch.
Maria (Eng): PR linked: https://git/repo/postlaunch-template (includes checklist and snippet).
Alex (PM): Great. Closing here — we'll run this for two sprints and reconvene. Thanks everyone :tada:
